name: Radiant Blade
description: A disciplined luminous blade associated with controlled force and clean martial execution.
narrative_effects: On strong success or critical success, may convert minor collateral harm to controlled impact in scene narration.

name: Wardbreaker Spear
description: A heavy spear forged or tuned for use against hardened barriers, ward-lines, and disciplined defensive formations.
narrative_effects: Grants narrative justification to contest reinforced barriers or shield lines.

name: Quicksilver Knife
description: A swift, finely balanced knife associated with silent work, speed, and clean close-quarters execution.
narrative_effects: Supports stealth takedown narration when the action already succeeds.

name: Skystring Bow
description: A high-performance bow known for unusual stability and precision in difficult air conditions.
narrative_effects: Enables long-range precision shots in high-wind scenes without contradiction.

name: Bastion Mail
description: A notable defensive harness associated with resilience, disciplined guard, and battlefield staying power.
narrative_effects: On partial failure in direct combat, reduce severity by one narrative step when plausible.

name: Aegis Kite Shield
description: A notable kite shield built or blessed for line-holding, interception, and allied protection.
narrative_effects: Supports ally-protection framing and line-holding outcomes.

name: Monksteel Handwraps
description: Reinforced handwraps designed for disciplined unarmed engagement against defended opponents.
narrative_effects: Enables meaningful unarmed engagement against armored foes.

name: Veilcloak
description: A concealment-oriented cloak associated with identity masking, presence control, and formal-space deception.
narrative_effects: Supports identity concealment checks in formal spaces.

name: Ghoststep Boots
description: Specialized boots associated with controlled footing, noise suppression, and infiltration movement.
narrative_effects: Supports silent movement framing in infiltration scenes.

name: Lockwhisper Picks
description: A refined lockpick set associated with quiet entry, speed, and practiced bypass work under pressure.
narrative_effects: Supports rapid bypass attempts under time pressure.

name: Hawkeye Lens
description: A precision observation lens associated with long-sight reconnaissance and careful remote assessment.
narrative_effects: Improves fictional positioning for long-sight reconnaissance.

name: Wayfarer Reins
description: Travel-grade reins associated with difficult route handling, hazard control, and disciplined mount or vehicle guidance.
narrative_effects: Supports difficult mount or vehicle control in hazardous terrain.

name: Aether Staff
description: A refined magical staff associated with stable channeling and structured multi-step arcane working.
narrative_effects: Supports stable channeling for multi-step arcane actions.

name: Rune Compass
description: A magical orientation device associated with pathfinding, magical bearings, and navigation through distorted environments.
narrative_effects: Supports magical orientation and pathfinding in distorted zones.

name: Sunvial Elixir
description: A potent restorative elixir intended for immediate treatment in scenes where intervention is possible.
narrative_effects: Restore moderate HP once per scene where immediate treatment is plausible.

name: Emberseal Paste
description: A prepared protective paste used to temporarily suppress heat and burn exposure in severe environments.
narrative_effects: Temporarily suppresses environmental burn exposure in volcanic scenes.

name: Sanctum Oil
description: A consecrated oil associated with purification, sanctification, and taint-cleansing rites.
narrative_effects: Supports purification or consecration attempts at tainted sites.

name: Oathbell of Accord
description: A formal vow-marking sacred instrument associated with binding promises, accord, and witnessed obligation.
narrative_effects: Supports negotiation scenes where formal vows are binding.

name: Resonance Lyre
description: A ritual-performance instrument associated with emotional regulation, crowd response, and coordinated ceremony.
narrative_effects: Supports crowd-calming or ritual synchronization actions.

name: Vault Cognition Tome
description: A restricted cognition-focused tome that grants controlled in-scene access to narrow specialized lore without serving as a permanent universal bypass.
narrative_effects: Grants temporary narrative access to specialized lore in-scene; not a permanent encyclopedic bypass.
